constraints: Passing a parameter to this command is reserved for testing purposes; freeing cache memory in production is not recommended for performance reasons.
By default (no parameter), the cache memory itself is left untouched and continues to be used for subsequent reads; only the data buffers are saved to disk.

overloadMerges.note: The two syntax lines are the same optional argument slot expressed as either a numeric byte count or the literal '*' marker; merged into one overload with a discriminated-union param instead of two overloads.

params.name: size

sentinelValues.meaning: save the cache and free the entire cache memory

params.description: Number of bytes to free from the cache, or '*' to free it entirely; if omitted, the cache is only saved to disk, not freed

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Immediately saves the data buffers to disk and, optionally, frees some or all of the cache memory.
